t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup styled as an engineering drawing sheet on deep navy. An inset pale hairline border with zone letters and numbers in small mono around all four edges and a small title block with mono document codes bottom-right. Inside: a small sans eyebrow and a large light-weight white sans headline, then a full-width four-column table with a boxed hairline grid for <CONTENT>. Flat, no shading, square corners, calm and official.
signature_idea: The router table is set inside a navy drawing sheet with zone border and title block, so the whole section reads as one engineering document.
strengths: drawing-sheet frame is a cheap, on-brand container device
navy, light headline and hairlines are on-brand
table is legible with short cells
title block gives a natural home for mono codes
weaknesses: plain table only, no visual idea beyond the frame
zone numbers along the bottom are out of order (5 between C and 4)
title block reads literally 'Title block' and 'document Code'
boxed grid is heavier than hairline row rules
no steel-blue accent or mono in the table
brand_fit_why: Navy sheet, light headline and hairlines fit, but it is a plain boxed table with garbled frame text and no accent.
